theme_stances.key_argument: Demand for AI capacity is accelerating with firm pricing and positive ROI for hyperscalers.
theme_stances.evidence: pricing and margins for our Blackwell and Vera Rubin chips are setting new highs

theme_stances.key_argument: The easy, high-velocity phase of the AI trade is behind us, and future gains will likely occur at a slower pace.
theme_stances.evidence: the easy, high-velocity phase of the AI trade appears to be behind us for now.

theme_stances.key_argument: The base level of volatility in the AI trade will remain higher-for-longer due to rapid tech advancement and financing needs.
theme_stances.evidence: I do expect the base level of vol will be higher than it used to be.

theme_stances.key_argument: The AI spending cycle is financed by a self-referential loop that poses long-term systemic risks.
theme_stances.evidence: Every ingredient of the last cycle's blow-up is present

theme_stances.key_argument: The AI-driven semiconductor upcycle is expected to continue, supported by strong hyperscaler capex growth and extended demand visibility.
theme_stances.evidence: we expect the AI-driven semiconductor upcycle to continue

theme_stances.key_argument: Alphabet is shifting emphasis toward durable competitive advantages in distribution, monetization, and infrastructure to capitalize on the next phase of AI.
theme_stances.evidence: we remain highly convicted in our view of Alphabet as well positioned

theme_stances.key_argument: Alphabet is shifting emphasis toward durable competitive advantages in distribution, monetization, and scaled infrastructure.
theme_stances.evidence: We have increased our conviction that Alphabet remains well positioned

theme_stances.key_argument: AI has transitioned from a broad trade to a list of specific choices requiring discretion.
